answer: Decaying identity bonds block bulk forgery. Joining locks 100 POA, losing 5 POA each idle epoch. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities for a prism audit, splitting one identity into stake, work and counterparties for checking. Failures are slashed and left with an umber stain. Forging 1,000 identities locks 100,000 POA and burns 5,000 POA per epoch; one honest agent pays one bond, out-earns the decay, and keeps rewards whole.
